target: Sony WebKit_1400 JavaScriptCore, interpreter-only (ENABLE_JIT/DFG/FTL OFF), AddressSanitizer, Debug
corpus: JSTests/stress from the same source drop
interpretation: No sanitizer report across ~4,000 regression tests. That is a clean bill of health for the shipped interpreter against bugs WebKit already knows about - it does not probe for unknown ones. Failures and timeouts are expected: much of JSTests needs the $vm test harness, and interpreter-only execution makes the heavy tests slow.
value: Establishes a trustworthy baseline: if a generated case later trips ASAN, the build is not simply noisy.
